verses.geez:
ወነሥኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ናዳብ ፡ ወአቢዩድ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ማዕጠንቶ ፡ ወወደዩ ፡ ውስቴቶን ፡ እሳተ ፡ ወወደዩ
                  ፡ ውስቴቶን ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እሳተ ፡ ዘእምባዕድ ፡ ዘኢአዘዞሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abiud, took each his censer, and put fire therein, and threw incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which the Lord did not command them,

translations.lxx: And the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abiud, took each his censer, and put fire therein, and threw incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which the Lord did not command them,
translations.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea cei doi fii ai lui Aaron, Nadab şi Abiud, luându-şi fiecare cădelniţa sa, au pus în ea foc, au turnat deasupra tămâie şi au adus înaintea Domnului foc străin, ce nu le poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ λαβόντες οἱ δύο υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν Ναδὰβ καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ, ἕκαστος τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ, ἐπέθηκαν ἐπʼ αὐτὸ πῦρ, καὶ ἐπέβαλον ἐπʼ αὐτὸ θυμίαμα, καὶ προσήνεγκαν ἔναντι Κυρίου πῦρ ἀλλότριον, ὃ οὐ προσέταξε Κύριος αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወወፅአት ፡ እሳት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበልዐቶሙ ፡ ወሞቱ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: and fire came forth from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.

translations.lxx: and fire came forth from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
translations.ron: Atunci a ieşit foc de la Domnul şi i-a mistuit şi au murit amândoi înaintea Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθε πῦρ παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἀπέθανον ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእለ ፡ ይቀርቡኒ ፡ እትቄደስ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡
                  ተዓይን ፡ እሴባሕ ፡ ወደንገፀ ፡ አሮን ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, This is the thing which the Lord spoke, saying, I will be sanctified among them that draw nigh to me, and I will be glorified in the whole congregation; and Aaron was pricked in his heart.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, This is the thing which the Lord spoke, saying, I will be sanctified among them that draw nigh to me, and I will be glorified in the whole congregation; and Aaron was pricked in his heart.
translations.kjv: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
translations.ron: Iar Moise a zis către Aaron: "Iată ce a voit să spună Domnul când a zis: Voi să fiu sfinţit prin cei ce se vor apropia de Mine şi înaintea adunării a tot poporul preaslăvit". Iar Aaron tăcea.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ἀαρὼν, τοῦτό ἐστιν, ὃ εἶπε Κύριος, λέγων, ἐν τοῖς ἐγγίζουσί μοι ἁγιασθήσομαι, καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ δοξασθήοσμαι· καὶ κατενύχθη Ἀαρών.

verses.geez:
ወጸውዖሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሚሳዴ ፡ ወለኤሊሳፈን ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኦዚሔል ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለአበ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሑሩ ፡
                  ንሥኡ ፡ አኀዊክሙ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ወአውፅእዎሙ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And Moses called Misadaë, and Elisaphan, sons of Oziel, sons of the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, Draw near and take your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

translations.lxx: And Moses called Misadaë, and Elisaphan, sons of Oziel, sons of the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, Draw near and take your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
translations.kjv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
translations.ron: Atunci a chemat Moise pe Misail şi Elţafan, fiii lui Uziel, unchiul lui Aaron, şi le-a zis: "Duceţi-vă de scoateţi pe fraţii voştri din locaşul cel sfânt şi-i duceţi afară din tabără!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε Μωυσῆς τὸν Μισαδάη, καὶ τὸν Ἐλισαφὰν, υἱοὺς Ὀζιὴλ, υἱοὺς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τοῦ πατρὸς Ἀαρὼν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, προσέλθατε καὶ ἄρατε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν ἐκ προσώπου τῶν ἁγίων ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς.

verses.geez: ወቦኡ ፡ ወአውፅእዎሙ ፡ በአልባሲሆሙ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And they came near and took them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses said.

translations.lxx: And they came near and took them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses said.
translations.kjv: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
translations.ron: Şi aceştia s-au dus şi i-au scos în hitoanele lor afară din tabără, cum zisese Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσῆλθον, καὶ ᾖραν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς χιτῶσιν αὐτῶν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, ὃν τρόπον εἶπε Μωυσῆς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለእልዓዛር ፡ ወለይታመር ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ርእሰክሙ ፡ ኢትቅርፁ ፡ ወአልባሲክሙኒ ፡ ኢትሥጥጡ ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ኢትሙቱ ፡ ወኢይኩን ፡ መንሱት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይን ፤ አኀዊክሙሰ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  [ይብክ]ይዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ውዕዩ ፡ እለ ፡ አውዐዮሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, and Eleazar and Ithamar his sons that were left, Ye shall not make bare your heads, and ye shall not tear your garments; that ye die not, and so there should be wrath on all the congregation: but your brethren, even all the house of Israel, shall lament for the burning, with which they were burnt by the Lord.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, and Eleazar and Ithamar his sons that were left, Ye shall not make bare your heads, and ye shall not tear your garments; that ye die not, and so there should be wrath on all the congregation: but your brethren, even all the house of Israel, shall lament for the burning, with which they were burnt by the Lord.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
translations.ron: Iar lui Aaron şi fiilor lui, Eleazar şi Itamar, le-a zis Moise; "Capetele voastre să nu vi le descoperiţi şi veşmintele voastre să nu vi le sfâşiaţi, ca să nu muriţi şi ca să nu atrageţi mânia asupra obştii întregi. Dar fraţii voştri, toată casa lui Israel, pot să plângă pe cei arşi, pe care i-a ars Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ἀαρὼν καὶ Ἐλεάζαρ καὶ Ἰθάμαρ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς καταλελειμμένους, τὴν κεφαλὴν ὑμῶν οὐκ ἀποκιδαρώσετε, καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια ὑμῶν οὐ διαῤῥήξετε, ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συναγωγὴν ἔσται θυμός· οἱ δὲ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν, πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ, κλαύσονται τὸν ἐμπυρισμὸν, ὃν ἐνεπυρίσθησαν ὑπὸ Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወእምኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ኢትፃኡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትሙቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ዘይቀብኡ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌክሙ
                  ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall not go forth from the door of the tabernacle of witness, that ye die not; for the Lord's anointing oil is upon you: and they did according to the word of Moses.

translations.lxx: And ye shall not go forth from the door of the tabernacle of witness, that ye die not; for the Lord's anointing oil is upon you: and they did according to the word of Moses.
translations.kjv: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
translations.ron: Din uşa cortului adunării să nu ieşiţi, ca să nu muriţi, căci aveţi pe voi mirul de ungere al Domnului!" Şi s-a făcut drept cuvântul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τὴς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου οὐκ ἐξελεύσεσθε, ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε· τὸ ἔλαιον γὰρ τῆς χρίσεως, τὸ παρὰ Κυρίου, ἐφʼ ὑμῖν, καὶ ἐποίησαν κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
translations.ron: Apoi grăind Domnul cu Aaron, a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος τῷ Ἀαρὼν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ወይነ ፡ ወሜሰ ፡ ኢትስተዩ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትበውኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ አው ፡
                  ሶበ ፡ ትበውኡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወኢትመውቱ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ በመዋዕሊክሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፤
verses.translation: Ye shall not drink wine nor strong drink, thou and thy sons with thee, whensoever ye enter into the tabernacle of witness, or when ye approach the altar, so shall ye not die; it is a perpetual statute for your generations,

translations.lxx: Ye shall not drink wine nor strong drink, thou and thy sons with thee, whensoever ye enter into the tabernacle of witness, or when ye approach the altar, so shall ye not die; it is a perpetual statute for your generations,
translations.kjv: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
translations.ron: "Vin şi sicheră să nu beţi, nici tu, nici fiii tăi, când intraţi în cortul adunării sau vă apropiaţi de jertfelnic, ca să nu muriţi. Acesta este aşezământ veşnic în neamul vostru.
translations.grk: οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ πίεσθε σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου μετὰ σοῦ, ἡνίκα ἐὰν εἰσπορεύησθε εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, ἢ προσπορευομένων ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνητε· νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν,

verses.geez:
ዘቦቱ ፡ ይትፈለጥ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ርኩሳን ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ንጹሓን ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢኮኑ ፡
                  ንጹሓነ ።
verses.translation: to distinguish between sacred and profane, and between clean and unclean,

translations.lxx: to distinguish between sacred and profane, and between clean and unclean,
translations.kjv: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
translations.ron: Ca să puteţi deosebi cele sfinte de cele nesfinte şi cele necurate de cele curate,
translations.grk: διαστεῖλαι ἀναμέσον τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τῶν βεβήλων, καὶ ἀναμέσον τῶν ἀκαθάρτων καὶ τῶν καθαρῶν,

verses.geez: ወትሜህሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ዘነገሮሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: and to teach the children of Israel all the statutes, which the Lord spoke to them by Moses.

translations.lxx: and to teach the children of Israel all the statutes, which the Lord spoke to them by Moses.
translations.kjv: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Şi ca să învăţaţi pe fiii lui Israel toate legile, pe care le-a poruncit lor Domnul prin Moise".
translations.grk: καὶ συμβιβάξειν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἅπαντα τὰ νόμιμα, ἃ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς αὐτοὺς διὰ χειρὸς Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለእልዓዛር ፡ ወለይታማር ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ እለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡
                  እምቍርባኑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብልዑ ፡ ናእተ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who survived, Take the sacrifice that is left of the burnt-offerings of the Lord, and ye shall eat unleavened bread by the altar: it is most holy.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who survived, Take the sacrifice that is left of the burnt-offerings of the Lord, and ye shall eat unleavened bread by the altar: it is most holy.
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
translations.ron: Iar Moise a zis către Aaron şi către fiii săi, Eleazar şi Itamar, care-i mai rămăseseră: "Luaţi prinosul de pâine, ce a rămas din jertfele Domnului, şi-l mâncaţi nedospit, lângă jertfelnic, că acesta este sfinţenie mare.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ἀαρὼν καὶ πρὸς Ἐλεάζαρ καὶ Ἰθάμαρ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀαρὼν τοὺς καταλειφθέντας, λάβετε τὴν θυσίαν τὴν καταλειφθεῖσαν ἀπὸ τῶν καρπωμάτων Κυρίου, καὶ φάγεσθε ἄζυμα παρὰ τὸ θυσιαστήριον· ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστί.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ሕግከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወሕጎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡ እምነ ፡ መሥዋዕቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ከማሁ
                  ፡ አዘዘኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And ye shall eat it in the holy place; for this is a statute for thee and a statute for thy sons, of the burnt-offerings to the Lord; for so it has been commanded me.

translations.lxx: And ye shall eat it in the holy place; for this is a statute for thee and a statute for thy sons, of the burnt-offerings to the Lord; for so it has been commanded me.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
translations.ron: Să-l mâncaţi însă în locul cel sfânt, că aceasta este partea ta şi partea fiilor tăi din jertfele Domnului; aşa mi s-a poruncit mie de la Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ φάγεσθε αὐτὴν ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ· νόμιμον γάρ σοι ἐστὶ, καὶ νόμιμον τοῖς υἱοῖς σου τοῦτο ἀπὸ τῶν καρπωμάτων Κυρίου· οὕτω γὰρ ἐντέταλταί μοι.

verses.geez:
ወተላዐኒ ፡ ዘመባእ ፡ ወአገዳኒ ፡ ዘመበእ ፡ ትበልዑ ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ ወቤትከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፤
                  ሕግከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወሕጎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡ ዘተውህበ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡
                  እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And ye shall eat the breast of separation, and the shoulder of the choice-offering in the holy place, thou and thy sons and thy house with thee; for it has been given as an ordinance for thee and an ordinance for thy sons, of the sacrifices of peace-offering of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And ye shall eat the breast of separation, and the shoulder of the choice-offering in the holy place, thou and thy sons and thy house with thee; for it has been given as an ordinance for thee and an ordinance for thy sons, of the sacrifices of peace-offering of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Iar pieptul legănat şi spata ridicată să le mâncaţi la loc curat, tu şi fiii tăi şi casa ta împreună cu tine, că acestea sunt date să fie partea ta şi partea fiilor tăi din jertfele de izbăvire ale fiilor lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ στηθύνιον τοῦ ἀφορίσματος, καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος φάγεσθε ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ, σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ ὁ οἶκός σου μετὰ σοῦ· νόμιμον γὰρ σοι, καὶ νόμιμον τοῖς υἱοῖς σου ἐδόθη ἀπὸ τῶν θυσιῶν τοῦ σωτηρίου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
አገደ ፡ ዘመባእ ፡ ወተላዕ ፡ ዘይፈልጡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ዘሥብሕ ፡ ያመጽእዎ ፡ ፈሊጦሙ ፡ ወይፈልጥዎ ፡ በቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይኩንከ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለደቂቅከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: They shall bring the shoulder of the choice-offering, and the breast of the separation upon the burnt-offerings of the fat, to separate for a separation before the Lord; and it shall be a perpetual ordinance for thee and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: They shall bring the shoulder of the choice-offering, and the breast of the separation upon the burnt-offerings of the fat, to separate for a separation before the Lord; and it shall be a perpetual ordinance for thee and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
translations.ron: Spata ridicată şi pieptul legănat să le aducă ei cu grăsime pentru ardere, legănându-le înaintea feţei Domnului, şi să fie acestea parte veşnică pentru tine şi împreună cu tine şi pentru fiii tăi şi pentru fiicele tale, cum a poruncit Domnul lui Moise".
translations.grk: Τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος, καὶ τὸ στηθύνιον τοῦ ἀφορίσματος ἐπὶ τῶν καρπωμάτων τῶν στεάτωι· προσοίσουσιν ἀφόρισμα ἀφορίσαι ἔναντι Κυρίου· καὶ ἔσται σοι καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου καὶ ταῖς θυγατράσι σου μετὰ σοῦ νόμιμον αἰώνιον, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወኀሠሦ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሐርጌ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወሶበ ፡ የኀሥሥ ፡ በዘ ፡ ወድአ ፡ ውዕየ ፡ ወተምዕዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዲበ
                  ፡ እልዓዛር ፡ ወይታመር ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እለ ፡ ተርፉ ።
verses.translation: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, but it had been consumed by fire; and Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,

translations.lxx: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, but it had been consumed by fire; and Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,
translations.kjv: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a căutat Moise ţapul de jertfă pentru păcat şi iată era ars. Şi s-a mâniat Moise pe Eleazar şi pe Itamar, fiii lui Aaron, care mai rămăseseră,
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν χίμαρον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ζητῶν ἐξεζήτησε Μωυσῆς· καὶ ὁ δὲ ἐνπεπύριστο· καὶ ἐθυμώθη Μωυσῆς ἐπὶ Ἐλεάζαρ καὶ Ἰθάμαρ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀαρὼν τοὺς καταλελειμμένους, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ኢበላዕክሙ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  ወወሀበክሙ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ትብልዑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኅድጉ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ወታስተስርዩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Why did ye not eat the sin-offering in the holy place? for because it is most holy he has given you this to eat, that ye might take away the sin of the congregation, and make atonement for them before the Lord.

translations.lxx: Why did ye not eat the sin-offering in the holy place? for because it is most holy he has given you this to eat, that ye might take away the sin of the congregation, and make atonement for them before the Lord.
translations.kjv: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
translations.ron: şi a zis: "Pentru ce n-an mâncat jertfa pentru păcat în locul cel sfânt? Că aceasta este sfinţenie mare şi vă e dată vouă, ca să ridicaţi păcatele obştii şi s-o curăţiţi înaintea Domnului.
translations.grk: διατί οὐκ ἐφάγετε τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ; ὅτι γὰρ ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστι, τοῦτο ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν φαγεῖν, ἵνα ἀφέλητε τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τῆς συναγωγῆς, καὶ ἐξιλάσησθε περὶ αὐτῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ [ለዘኢ]ቦአ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ በውስ[ጥ] ፡ ትበልዕዎ ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ በከመ ፡
                  ተአዘዝኩ ።
verses.translation: For the blood of it was not brought into the holy place: ye shall eat it within, before the Lord, as the Lord commanded me.

translations.lxx: For the blood of it was not brought into the holy place: ye shall eat it within, before the Lord, as the Lord commanded me.
translations.kjv: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
translations.ron: Iată sângele ei nu s-a dus înăuntrul locaşului sfânt şi voi trebuia s-o mâncaţi în locul cel sfânt, cum mi s-a poruncit mie de la Domnul".
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ εἰσήχθη τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον· κατὰ πρόσωπον ἔσω φάγεσθε αὐτὸ ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ, ὃν τρόπον μοι συνέταξε Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ወተናገሮ ፡ አሮን ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ዮም ፡ አመ ፡ ቀደሱ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ፡ ወመሥዋዕቶሙኒ ፡ ቅድመ
                  ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ረከበተኒ ፡ ዮጊ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ ሠና[የ] ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ እብላዕ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡
                  ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: And Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, If they have brought nigh to-day their sin-offerings, and their whole-burnt-offerings before the Lord, and these events have happened to me, and yet I should eat to-day of the sin-offerings, would it be pleasing to the Lord?

translations.lxx: And Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, If they have brought nigh to-day their sin-offerings, and their whole-burnt-offerings before the Lord, and these events have happened to me, and yet I should eat to-day of the sin-offerings, would it be pleasing to the Lord?
translations.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
translations.ron: Aaron însă a zis către Moise: "Iată, astăzi şi-au adus ei jertfa lor pentru păcat şi arderea lor de tot înaintea Domnului şi, după cele ce mi s-au întâmplat, de aş fi mâncat astăzi jertfa pentru păcat, oare ar fi fost aceasta plăcut Domnului?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν Ἀαρὼν πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, εἰ σήμερον προσαγιόχασι τὰ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα αὐτῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ συμβέβηκέ μοι τοιαῦτα, καὶ φάγομαι τὰ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας σήμερον, μὴ ἀρεστὸν ἔται Κυρίῳ;

verses.geez: ወሰምዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአደሞ ።
verses.translation: And Moses heard it, and it pleased him.

translations.lxx: And Moses heard it, and it pleased him.
translations.kjv: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
translations.ron: Şi a auzit acestea Moise şi le-a socotit răspunsul îndreptăţit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσε Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἤρεσεν αὐτῷ.
